name: MedMCQA
intro: MedMCQA是一个包含193,155道医学多项选择题的大规模数据集，来源覆盖专业模拟题、在线测试系列以及AIIMS PG与NEET PG考试；涵盖约2,400个医学主题和21个学科，用于评估广泛医学知识与推理能力。
build_method: 医学考试题收集, 纯文本质量清洗, 按考试防泄漏划分
eval_feature: 论文判别式阅读器、可选检索上下文与公开盲测提交流程
build_method_en: Medical-exam collection, text-only quality cleaning, exam-based leakage-safe splitting
eval_feature_en: Discriminative reader study with optional retrieval context plus a public blind-test submission path
intro_en: MedMCQA is a large-scale multiple-choice question answering dataset designed around medical entrance exams. It contains exactly 193,155 questions from mock and online test series plus AIIMS and NEET PG exams, covering about 2,400 topics and 21 medical subjects.

drawio_review_note: Source audit fixed the PMLR 174 paper/arXiv:2203.14371v1, official Git commit c59ef14ca1990266c4107c7864b45a20fd93e5e0, and the current official Google Drive archive at SHA-256 16c1fbc6f47d548d2af7837b18e893aa45f45c0be9bda0a9adfff3c625bf9262. Per-file SHA-256 values are afa1b32379409fce3090a39411a769e5f1739d8bd2c43acb0806a3e070f711ba for train.json, a2b5f53890f4e742b728378fb847bc5338088d48ea01218676379f587270af31 for dev.json, and 5cfb861ee583911a311b7bfe7c2de0db83bbaab2d3a7711ff949e489013187ae for test.json. The paper construction path covers professional mock and online test series, AIIMS PG from 1991 onward, NEET PG from 2001 onward, record formation with four options and an answer key, text-only/self-contained filtering, curated removal terms including equation, India, graph, and map, heuristic HTML/symbol/URL/whitespace and option-format cleanup, human-supervised Grammarly proofreading, deduplication, exam-based splits, and removal of dev/test questions above 0.9 pairwise Levenshtein similarity. Section 2.3 is internally ambiguous: it says missing or null candidates were omitted, but also lists missing options among heuristic cases identified and corrected. Because no construction scripts or adjudication rules are released, the diagram conservatively routes missing/null candidates to exclusion and only option-format/spelling repairs through cleanup, while labeling that structural-versus-repairable distinction as unreported rather than paper-confirmed. This keeps the exclusion and repair paths reachable without claiming construction logic beyond the paper, whose exact sites/books, full keyword list, crawl/edit/dedup/split implementations, sampling, and adjudication rules are not released. Table 2 and the fixed archive agree on 182,822 train, 4,183 dev, and 6,150 test rows (193,155 total), while the abstract/README claim more than 194K and the adjacent prose plus fixed README swap the dev/test counts; the diagram uses table/archive counts and exposes both conflicts. Every public test row lacks cop and exp, so public test gold and explanations remain private. The paper evaluation uses BERT, SciBERT, BioBERT, and PubMedBERT readers with or without DPR/Wikipedia or PubMedBERT/PubMed retrieval, four question-option sequences, PubMed passages truncated to 250 tokens, 2 Tesla T4 GPUs, five epochs, learning rate 2e-4, batch 16, highest validation score, a linear layer plus softmax and argmax, and overall/subject accuracy; it has no generative prompt or text parser. Fixed-code drift is explicit: there are no construction or retrieval scripts; model.py concatenates question plus option into one segment, yielding approximately [CLS] Q O [SEP] without context and [CLS] exp [SEP] Q O [SEP] with context, rather than the paper's separate Q/O boundaries; checkpointing minimizes val_loss with patience-2 early stopping rather than selecting the highest validation score across all five epochs; and max_len 192, dropout 0.4, and seed 42 are code-specific settings. The first unmodified-public-test failure occurs even earlier than missing labels: the official archive provides newline-delimited train.json, dev.json, and test.json, while train.py hardcodes train.csv, test.csv, and dev.csv and dataset.py calls pd.read_csv; the repository provides no JSON-to-CSV adapter. Even after an undisclosed conversion, dataset.py unconditionally computes cop - 1 and, with context, reads exp before train.py calls trainer.test, so the public test copy with neither cop nor exp still cannot execute unchanged. The official alternative is a two-column CSV with id and Prediction (correct option), 1-based integer predictions, and Google-Form upload; external denominator and missing-prediction rules are unreported. The official homepage has live with-context and without-context leaderboards. The repository is MIT, the data archive embeds no license, and rights for scraped exam or book questions are not separately documented. Fixed requirements pin numpy 1.19.4, pandas 1.1.3, torch 1.5.1, transformers 3.1.0, pytorch-lightning 1.0.8, and wandb 0.10.12. A converted private or labeled-copy code path is kept separate from the paper reader and public submission paths so it does not inherit paper-only retrieval, input-boundary, or checkpoint-selection claims. Formal publication evidence [site-a11t-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3285×1409 (English) and 3285×1409 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3283×1407 and 3283×1407. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
